title: Parameter gateway and stream resilience for /v1/chat parity (stop/logprobs + toolcall handshake)
author: Liam Chen
release_notes: Adds a v1/chat parameter gateway that centralizes param translation and validation for OpenAI parity; normalizes stop and logprob semantics across streaming and non-streaming paths; improves tool/function-call handshake and stream fragment reassembly. Includes observability hooks and migration notes. No breaking changes for existing SDK consumers.
description:
Motivation: customers expect /v1/chat.completions parity for legacy OpenAI clients while we preserve Redwood runtime performance and structured tool outputs. This PR introduces a shallow parameter gateway that canonicalizes incoming v1/chat params, enforces a single source of truth for stop/logprob behavior, and hardens the streaming handshake for tool/function calls so that fragmented Deltas are reassembled deterministically.

What changed (summary): consolidated param translation and validation into api/compat/v1_chat_gateway.go; introduced a small translator in api/compat/param_translator.py to centralize role/stop/logprob rules; consolidated streaming boundary handling into runtime/stream/stream_coordinator.rs and added explicit fragment sequence numbers and heartbeat reconciliation; improved KV cache lifetime hints in runtime/kv_cache/cache_manager.cpp to avoid token duplication on retries; added compatibility shims in sdk/python/openai_compat.py to keep existing client semantics.

Behavioral impacts: stop semantics now prefer explicit stop arrays, with fallback to heuristics that match OpenAI historical behavior; logprob reporting is now consistent between streaming and final payloads (we emit a combined logprobs.summary when streaming was used); function/tool call handshake uses a 3-way fragment acknowledgment to avoid mid-stream truncation of tool responses.

Testing and validation: unit tests added in tests/unit for param translation rules; integration tests in tests/integration/test_chat_parity.py cover streaming recovery, stop normalization, and toolcall reassembly across network interruptions. Benchmarks run on perf-canary showed <3% median latency increase with typical batching, and 18% reduction in token duplication rate in simulated retries.

Migration notes: SDKs continue to work; customers using ad-hoc stop heuristics should validate against a small prompt set. See docs/openai_compat/v1_chat.md for detailed examples and suggested guardrails.

Checklist: [x] param gateway implemented and covered by unit tests; [x] streaming fragments reassembly implemented; [x] toolcall handshake implemented and tested; [x] integration tests passing; [x] docs updated.

Context: closes ENG-1098 (parity), touches ENG-1145 (streaming resilience).

compat: python shim for OpenAI client behaviors
kv-cache: lifetime hints + dedupe on retry
tests: integration + unit cases for parity and fragment reassembly
review_comments: Maya Singh: Please double-check the fallback ordering for stop arrays vs string stops — the implementation should prefer explicit arrays when provided.
Liam Chen: Addressed: explicit arrays short-circuit heuristics and added a unit test demonstrating fallback behavior (tests/unit/test_param_translator.py).
Carlos Ortega: Streaming coordinator looks good but add a defensive check for out-of-order fragments — otherwise reassembly might hang on a dropped seq.
Liam Chen: Added timeout and gap detection with a small backoff window; left a TODO to consider an optional max-buffer-size config. See runtime/stream/stream_coordinator.rs commit 9f3a2c.
Evelyn Park: Can you document the non-breaking guarantees and the expected behavior for clients that relied on previous logprob streaming shape?
Liam Chen: Expanded docs/openai_compat/v1_chat.md with explicit before/after examples and a migration snippet for Python and TypeScript SDKs.
Maya Singh: Approving after CI green and one minor nits fix merged.
ci_checks: ci/build: pass (linux, go, rust, cpp build)
merge_outcome: Merged by squash on 2026-03-02 after 3 approvals and CI green. Merge commit: 7a1e3b4 (squash). Release tagged as v2026.03.02-chat-compat.
notes_for_cherry_pick: Backport to release/2026-02 required for customers on older dedicated clusters; see backport script in scripts/release_notes/ and coordinate with infra for deployment window.
security_considerations: No new secrets. Param gateway sanitizes role/system content and enforces size limits to protect from oversized messages. Observability exports redact tokens and user PII by default.
rollout_plan: Gradual rollout: feature flag gated for 24h in canary region, then ramp to 25/50/100% over 48h if no errors. Automatic rollback on error rate > 2x baseline.
customer_impact: Minimal. Improves resilience for streaming tool outputs and reduces token duplication on retries. Some customers may notice logprob field shape normalization; docs include examples to adapt.
acknowledgements: Thanks to runtime and observability teams for help with perf runs and dashboards: @Maya Singh, @Carlos Ortega, @Evelyn Park, @InfraOps.
human_readable_summary: Implements a v1/chat parameter gateway and stream resilience changes to achieve closer OpenAI parity while keeping deterministic toolcall behavior and stable streaming semantics. Merged after tests and reviews.
